description: The Shannon entropy of a Collatz trajectory's odd/even step sequence encodes structural information about the starting number. Numbers with high delay have step sequences with entropy approaching the theoretical maximum.
mathematical_formalization: Let sigma(n) = (s_1, ..., s_{D(n)}) be the parity sequence. H(n) = -p*log(p) - (1-p)*log(1-p) where p = O(n)/D(n). High-delay numbers maximize H(n) while maintaining C(n) near ln(2)/ln(3).
analogical_connections: Maximum entropy distributions in statistical mechanics
DNA sequence entropy and functional information content
implementation_hypothesis: Compute running Shannon entropy of parity sequence during iteration. Abort early if entropy drops below threshold.
experiment_seed: Compute Shannon entropy of parity sequences for all 147 known delay records. Plot H(n) vs D(n) and fit regression.
